tldr: Sun in the 5th house routes identity and life force through joy and self-expression.
body: With the Sun in the 5th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through creativity, joy, romance, pleasure, play, and children. This makes how you create, flirt, play, risk, and let pleasure be part of life a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through joy and self-expression.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in joy and self-expression.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
